_provenance: Condition registry for the July 2026 main study (and later additions). Paths are relative to zylia_analysis/. June pilot outputs (results/, results/gt, results/virtual, results/virtual_selfcal, results/optim/predictions.json) are frozen artifacts: no condition may write into them. calibration.mode 'self' fits the Zylia mount on this condition's own pink-noise trials; 'external' applies the mount from the source condition's summary.json. mount_model: offset | rotation | auto.

vbap_gtmount._note: Sensitivity check: same VBAP data scored under the ground-truth mount instead of its own self-fit (mount-transfer disagreement bound).

atmos._note: Flip enabled to true once the Dolby Atmos sessions are recorded.

ambi._note: Recorded 2026-07-15 but EXCLUDED: the three elevation blocks carry a large per-block frame rotation (~91 deg azimuth spread, tracking recording time not elevation) traced to a data-collection issue (mic reorientation and/or per-block decode frame). No defensible VBAP comparison until provenance is resolved. Do not re-enable without that. See memory ambisonics-data-status.

ambi_gtmount._note: Ambisonics under the ground-truth mount; EXCLUDED with the ambi condition (per-block frame confound). Kept as infrastructure for the post-provenance re-analysis.

comparisons.name: room_effect
comparisons._note: delta = CAVE - anechoic ground truth (positive = the room hurts); auto-restricts to the shared 12-azimuth x 3-elevation cells.

comparisons.name: vbap_gtmount_vs_gt
comparisons._note: Primary complete-sphere rendering penalty: VBAP scored under the ground-truth mount (no phantom-based position exclusions).

_excluded_comparisons_note: Ambisonics comparisons (ambi_vs_gt, ambi_gtmount_vs_gt, vbap_vs_ambi) were removed 2026-07-17: the ambi data has a per-block frame confound (data-collection issue). results/ambi and results/ambi_gtmount are retained on disk for the future provenance investigation but are not wired into any comparison. See memory ambisonics-data-status.
